The PORCTRL parameters are the ST7789 datasheet defaults. Cross check: MADCTL 0xB4 has the RGB/BGR bit set, which independently matches the BGR565 channel swap found in the UI decode (finding-0007). The identification came out of triaging an old offset catalogue whose entry called these "T5L register writes" -- T5L is a DWIN display ASIC, a label left over from the period when the SoC was believed to be DWIN rather than Nuvoton.

Topic: USB IRQ Registration
Statement: usbd_irq_setup (0x002AF80C) registers USB IRQ id 0x10 via 0x002A1E88 with r2=0x00109AC4; the dispatcher indexes a handler table at base 0x00000890. Der Satz "not mapped inside APP.bin" ist damit erledigt: an file+0xB1AC4 steht ein sauberer Prolog str lr,[sp,#-4]! -- der ISR liegt in APP.bin. Die Handlertabelle bei 0x00000890 liegt in der RW-Region (CL-BOOT-REC-114) und ist dort anfangs null, wird also zur Laufzeit gefuellt. GEMESSEN 2026-10-12 (Basis 0x58000): REGISTRIERUNG. usbd_irq_setup (0x10780C) ruft bei 0x1078CC bl 0xF9E88 mit r0=1, r1=0x10, r2=[0x10799C]=0x109AC4, danach bl 0xF99D0 mit r0=0x10 (schreibt 1<<0x10 nach AIC 0xB8000120) und bl 0xFA0B8 mit r0=0x7F. 0xF9E88 schreibt das Level in das AIC-Quellregister 0xB8000000+(n&~3) und verzweigt ueber die Sprungtabelle bei 0xF9F2C nach r0: Level 0 -> Tabelle 0x890 (Pool 0xF9F80), Level 1..7 -> Tabelle 0x810 (Pool 0xF9F84). FUN_00109AC4 liest seine Basen aus dem Pool bei 0x10A360: 0xB1008000 (USBD_BA), 0xB1008704 (PHY_CTL), 0x8190 (Struktur), 0x82B0, 0x9E4, Konstanten 0x10A/0x106/0x10E fuer USB_IRQ_ENB, 0x9D0, 0x82A6, 0x9D4. Topic: Ghidra Scalar Search Misses Constant-Pool Literals

Topic: USB-MSC LUN Starts At Raw SD 0x2A614000
Statement: The sector at 0x2A614000 is an MBR: partition type 0x06 (FAT16), start LBA 63, 131,009 sectors = 67,076,608 bytes = 63.97 MiB, signature 0x55AA. 0x2A614000 + 63*512 = 0x2A61BE00, exactly the MINI boot sector, whose own BPB carries hidden_sectors = 63 and total_sectors32 = 131,009. So the drive the host sees over USB begins at 0x2A614000, and 3:/ is the FAT16 partition inside it. That explains the 63-sector offset that made 0x2A61BE00 look like an oddly unaligned volume start. The sector is byte-identical in sdcard.work.img and after boot; the minimal image had omitted it and the firmware recreated it exactly, which is itself the proof that the firmware maintains it.

Topic: Firmware Cleans The MINI Volume At Boot
Statement: On boot the firmware cleared the root directory of volume 3 and freed the corresponding FAT entries. Removed were a "System Volume Information" directory (SYSTEM~1, attribute 0x16, a Windows artefact) and two already-deleted 0xE5 entries for UI-QVGA.bin and ZK-INKJET-UI-*.bin. The FAT went from f8ffffff ffffffff ffff to f8ffffff, i.e. the allocated clusters were released. Anything a host leaves on the MINI drive is therefore subject to a tidy-up at the next boot.
Next_Test: Place a harmless file on the MINI volume, boot, and check whether it survives. That distinguishes a blanket wipe from a selective cleanup and decides whether a file-drop control scheme is viable at all.

Topic: Host-To-Raw-SD Mapping Located In Code
Statement: The constant 0x2A614000 (the USB LUN base) appears in the literal pool at VA 0x21CAAC, used by two functions: usb_lun_write_blocks (0x21CA60) and usb_lun_read_blocks (0x21C998), now renamed. write does dst = 0x2A614000 + (hostLBA<<9) and calls sd_fmi_block_io (0x294584); read is the mirror. So the PC-to-device write channel exists in the firmware already: a host sector X written over USB-MSC lands at raw SD 0x2A614000 + X*512. The callers are the MSC SCSI layer (msc_scsi_dispatch_278bb0 at 0x278BB0, plus FUN_0022CDE4 and FUN_002BAD5C). This is the read/write half of the "slave" path and needs no patch. Topic: Document Store Is Not Reachable Through The USB LUN -- Confirmed, And The Reader Runs The Other Way
Statement: The USB-exposed disk begins at 0x2A614000 and its FAT16 partition (3:/) runs from 0x2A61BE00. The document store sits at 0x28800000, which is BELOW the LUN base, so a host writing to the MINI drive cannot reach the store directly over USB -- the two live in different regions of the raw card. Writing a label from the PC therefore is not "drop a file on the MINI drive"; it needs either (a) direct raw SD access with the card in a reader, or (b) a firmware path that copies from 3:/ into the store, which is exactly what the update chain does for firmware files (CL-BOOT-REC-103/107). Whether a comparable copy path exists for documents is the open question for the slave goal. DECIDED 2026-08-31 (probe B2), negative. The reader exists and is FUN_00265B08: it walks all 100 slots, forms the address as 0x28800000 + index * 0x4D000 via mla, reads 16 header bytes through the raw primitive FUN_00232434 (a raw card address, not a file handle), checks the magic 0x2022, reads the slot and writes it out with fopen("3:/%d-%s","wb+"). Direction is store -> host, i.e. an export, not an import. The target test is negative for all eight address-forming sites found: base and stride are parameters of the scan routine, not one fixed pair, and 100 * 0x4D000 from 0x28800000 ends to the byte at 0x2A614000 -- the LUN base itself. No slot lies at or above it, so no slot is USB-writable and there is no patch-free host-to-store bridge along this path. The self-running string candidates were checked too: the resource and font loaders read from 3:/ but write nothing into the store, and inkjet-lite-vadj-sample.csv is opened "wb" and written, not read. This leaves the eight-byte window patch (CL-USB-REC-119) as the route for the transport half of the goal. Topic: Application Firmware Does Not Expose MSC By Itself
Statement: Decided by the operator, who has established this before and confirmed it today: the printer firmware does NOT enumerate as mass storage on its own. It requires the menu action Setup -> USB. The strings "USB aktualisieren ...", "Refresh USB...", "Waiting for connection..." and "Device is connected!" belong to that handler. The enumeration seen without a menu press was the boot ROM (idProduct 9396, WPMUSB) with the SD card removed, not the firmware. Topic: Boot ROM Code Upload -- Value Is Recovery, Not Control
Statement: The IBR mass-storage mode is the vendor programming path. vendor/N32905_NonOS_Tool/TurboWriter/ holds the "TurboWriter Tool User Guide.pdf" and FA93_musb.bin (187,416 bytes), which is the loader stub the tool pushes into the chip over exactly this channel; FA93_musb_FullSpeed.bin is the full-speed variant. The device side is in the BSP as source: SDWRITER/Src/Writer.c, SPIWRITER/Src/Writer.c, NANDWRITER/Src/Writer.c, plus UDC/lib/w55fa93_MSC_* for the USB layer. For the goal of driving the printer from the PC this outranks patching APP.bin: it runs code the host supplies, needs no SD card, touches no stored firmware, and a power cycle with the card inserted restores normal operation. STRATEGIE-KORREKTUR 2026-08-19: dieser Pfad ist NICHT der Hauptweg zum Ziel. Wer eigenen Code auf dem Chip ausfuehrt, muss den Druckkopf selbst ansteuern -- Pulsbreiten, HA/HP-Timing, VADJ. Genau dieses Wissen ist am Geraet nicht rekonstruierbar und soll auch nicht rekonstruiert werden. Der IBR-Pfad fuehrt damit zwangslaeufig zu "Firmware neu schreiben", was ausdrueckliches Nichtziel ist. Sein bleibender Wert ist die Wiederherstellung: ein gebricktes Geraet laesst sich ohne Kartenleser zurueckholen.

Topic: Uploaded Code Runs In RAM -- Objection Answered
Statement: Answered in the vendor documentation. The TurboWriter guide states the tool "is connected to Turbo writer firmware which loaded from PC to N329/N9H2X series by USB boot" -- the boot ROM receives a binary over USB and executes it. FA93_musb.bin confirms it structurally: header magic 0x2054564E ("NVT ") followed by execution address, size and version, then from offset 0x10 (16-byte header, offset corrected 2026-10-18, CL-BOOT-REC-110) a genuine ARM vector table (eight times E59FF018 = LDR PC,[PC+0x18], and EAFFFFFE = B . as the abort stub). For the N329x3 variant the header carries execution address 0x00400000 and size 0x2DC08 = 187,400 bytes, which lies inside the 8 MB DDR. So the SD card is the boot medium, not a mandatory waypoint: writing to the card is what the vendor payload does, not what the channel requires. Chapter 1.3 of the guide goes further and documents a "Download and run" function that loads an arbitrary host binary to a chosen buffer address and executes it. CONFIRMED on the board 2026-10-18: FA93_musb.bin uploaded through the boot ROM with n329-usbboot ran and enumerated as 0416:5593 (WINBOND, WPMUSB). 0x00400000 is the execution address from the IBR header, not an APP address (CL-BOOT-REC-113).

Topic: IBR Image Header Format
Statement: Header size corrected 2026-10-18 (first version: 32 bytes, code from 0x20). Images the boot ROM takes over USB carry a 16-byte header: magic 0x2054564E ('NVT '), execution address (also the load address), body size in bytes, version as bytes yy mm dd vv (0x22080903 = 2022/08/09-V03). The body starts at file offset 0x10 with the ARM vector table: eight times E59FF018, its literal pool at 0x30 (reset -> 0x00400070), 'b .' stubs from 0x50. Values: N329x3 FA93_musb.bin exec 0x00400000, size 0x2DC08 = 187,400 = file size 187,416 - 16; N329x1 exec 0x00150000, size 187,308 = file size - 16. TurboWriter.exe V2.30.003 (N329x3, image base 0x400000), upload routine 0x41B530: fread of 16 bytes at 0x41BABC, size from +8 at 0x41BB06, exec address from +4 at 0x41BB0F, seek to 0x10 at 0x41BBE4, then 'size' bytes are sent. On the board (2026-10-18) the body sent from 0x10 to 0x00400000 ran and enumerated as 0416:5593; with the body taken from 0x20 the reset vector would land on a 'b .' stub. Not to be confused with the 32-byte boot code header on the SD card (IBR_BOOT_STRUCT_T, CL-BOOT-REC-121). The guide text names 0x000F00000 generically, which contradicts both binaries and looks like a typo -- the per-chip value in the header is authoritative. DDR initialisation appears to be done by the boot ROM on this family: the guide notes DRAM init was REMOVED from the IBR for N3292X/N9H26K5 and that users must add it there, an exception that is not stated for N3290X. 0x00400000 is the execution address from the IBR header, not an APP address (CL-BOOT-REC-113).

Topic: Stage-1 Wire Protocol -- Ten-Byte 0x06 Vendor CDBs Over Bulk-Only, Read From TurboWriter And Run On The Board
Statement: ANSWERED 2026-10-18, not by a capture as planned but by static analysis of TurboWriter.exe V2.30.003 (N329x3) and runs on the board. Stage 1 is plain Bulk-Only Transport (31-byte CBW, optional data phase, 13-byte CSW) with ten-byte vendor CDBs: opcode 0x06, sub-command in byte 1, arguments little endian from byte 2. Sequence for boot ROM 1.00: 06 51 01 connect (IN; the tool retries up to 10 times, 100 ms apart), 06 52 and 06 53 with the clock-skew pair DQSODS 0x1010 and CKDQSDS 0x888800 (the values of the SD card's boot header, CL-BOOT-REC-121), 06 55 load address, 06 72 <u24> one OUT data block of at most 0x10000 bytes, repeated, 06 60 execute. The TurboWriter function behind each command is listed in docs/protocol.md of the sibling repository n329-usbboot (0x41E990, 0x41F050, 0x41F110, 0x41EA30, 0x41E8A0, 0x41EAF0). Its Linux implementation n329usb ran the sequence on the board: FA93_musb.bin uploaded with every CSW passed and the image enumerated as 0416:5593 (15:00:59), and BOOT.bin plus an APP block were started the same way. Not done: a wire capture of TurboWriter itself. Stage 2 (opcodes 0x61-0x66 of the TurboWriter firmware) is known by CDB layout only. Original row: the handshake is in no source available here; run the vendor tool once and capture what it sends.

Topic: The Existing Firmware Is The Asset, Not The Obstacle
Statement: Strategic decision. The goal is a printer driven from the PC, not a replacement firmware. The vendor firmware already holds the one thing that cannot be recovered by measurement: how to fire the printhead -- pulse widths, HA/HP sequencing, VADJ control. Any route that runs own code on the bare chip inherits the obligation to reproduce all of it. A patch does not: it has to understand interfaces, not physics, and calls the routine that already knows the timing. The question therefore is not "how do I execute my own code" but "where is the print entry point and what is the smallest thing that can call it". I had drifted toward the most powerful primitive instead of the cheapest path; this row exists so that drift is on record.

Topic: The Firmware Embeds Zint, The Open Source Barcode Library

And unlike the UI strings, these DO have cross-references, which makes them a way into the code: each numbered message is emitted by one known Zint function, so ZBarcode_Encode and its caller can be identified by matching the message catalogue against the upstream sources. Topic: Zint Call Chain Located -- And It Ends At The Display, Not At The Print Head
Statement: FUN_0022647C (0x22647C-0x22714B) is the symbology dispatch: it holds all six "Symbology out of range, using Code 128" strings and calls the per-symbology encoders, among them the QR encoder at 0x27406C (which carries "566: Error correction level H not available") and the UPC/EAN block at 0x24C8D8/0x24C950, plus 0x257378, 0x25917C, 0x287A2C, 0x28A53C, 0x2AFB50, 0x2B3770, 0x2B3A94. FUN_0022714C wraps it, and FUN_002302EC (0x2302EC-0x230A5F, 23 callees) calls that wrapper -- shape and size match Zint library.c around ZBarcode_Encode_Segs. Two independent chains reach it from ui_main_loop: ui_main_loop(0x26A8B4, 0x26BB7C) -> FUN_002C31C8 -> FUN_002C2098 -> FUN_002302EC, and ui_main_loop(0x26B86C) -> FUN_0025B338 -> FUN_002C3554 -> FUN_002302EC. The exported names are stripped; identification rests on the message catalogue. The embedded Zint predates current master -- the string "using Code 128" no longer exists upstream. CLOSED 2026-08-31 (probe B1). The three callees of FUN_002302EC that were still unexamined do NOT lead into rasterisation or print output. FUN_002BAD40 (24 bytes) is a trampoline into FUN_0021D0C0, and FUN_002BAD5C reaches FUN_0021CAB0; both are the SPI0 display primitives of CL-DISPLAY-REC-004 (fill and 16-bit block transfer). Neither is barcode-specific: they have 40 and 22 inbound xrefs spread across the whole UI, of which exactly one each comes from FUN_002302EC (0x23034C and 0x230A28). FUN_002A10C8 allocates a working buffer, fills it and frees it again inside the same function, and has a second caller FUN_0026EDDC which references ".jpg", ".png" and ".bmp" -- image handling, not encoding. No callee carries a numbered Zint error string. POSITIVE CONTROL for this negative finding: the same callee traversal did resolve a complete output path (SPI0 command/data senders, register names from the BSP header), so the method demonstrably finds output paths where they exist. CONSEQUENCE: a function that both encodes and emits CASET/RAMWR is not ZBarcode_Encode_Segs; FUN_002302EC is better read as a render routine containing or calling the encoder, and the library.c mapping in the first half of this row is weakened accordingly. Topic: A PC-Composed Document Is Accepted By The Device
Statement: PROVEN 2026-08-19. Topic: The Print Key Input Is GPE9 (Pin 118)
Statement: boot_init calls FUN_0026FBF8 at 0x0025B120; that function is gpio_read(0x10, 9). FUN_00231EC4 maps port mask 0x10 to the pointer stored at 0x00231F30, which is 0xB800104C -- the PIN register of GPIOE (GPIO base 0xB8001000, port stride 0x10, +0x0C is the input register). Bit 9 is therefore GPE9. If the bit is set at boot the firmware emits "Please release the print key!" (string at 0x0025B25C, loaded via adr at 0x0025B16C, which is why the Ghidra xref count showed 0). FUN_0025C41C reads the same input twice during operation, so it is polled at runtime and not only at boot. The restored pinout lists pin 118 as GPE[9] / NCS1_ and marks it untraced; pin 117, GPE[10], carries the MT6701 encoder. CAVEAT: this is a firmware-side derivation only. The pin has not been rung out on the board. CONFIRMED IN CODE 2026-08-22: the block containing VA 0x25B16C references the string "Please release the print key!" at VA 0x25B25C via an adr immediate, and calls FUN_0026FBF8 twice, at VA 0x25B120 and 0x25B1CC. FUN_0026FBF8 is the only caller that reads a port E pin, passing bit 9 with a deadline of tick+0xBB8 (CL-HARDWARE-REC-112). Two calls around a release message is a wait-for-press then wait-for-release pattern. The same block also calls 0x262778 (settings_load_validate_save) and 0x26A7F8 (the menu dispatcher). What is measured: the polled pin is GPE[9] and the polling routine is called from the code that emits the print-key message. What is NOT measured: that pin 118 is physically wired to the print key -- the pinout marks pin 118 untraced, and only a continuity check makes this O3. BLOCK DISASSEMBLED 2026-08-31 (probe B1). VA 0x25B0C0-0x25B250 lies entirely inside boot_init (0x25B0C4-0x25B24B); what follows is boot_init's own literal pool with the string embedded in it. Between the two FUN_0026FBF8 calls the block evaluates the first return value (tst r0,#1), calls FUN_002BFE9C, and -- only if two global pointer slots (*0x4CFC0 and *0x560, both filled by FUN_0022F530 BEFORE the first poll) are non-null -- builds a 0x38-byte stack structure from fields +0x1B0..+0x1C8 of a global at 0x1236F8, passes the string pointer in it to FUN_002BD160, reads the tick via FUN_00243F60 and computes deadline = tick + 0xBB8 (0x800 + 0x3B8, exactly as this row states). The second call sits in the timeout loop. NO global state is written between the two polls -- only stack stores. boot_init has no direct BL caller: the only xref is a COMPUTED_CALL at 0x200280 in FUN_00200264 onto a 4-byte chunk at 0x273EE4 that branches to 0x25B0C4, and FUN_00200264 is called twice from 0x20005C and 0x20007C, i.e. from startup code. CORRECTION TO THIS ROW'S OWN EXPECTATION: the block is the power-on check (key held at boot -> warn and wait for release), not the print action, and it is NOT an entry point for triggering a print from outside. That expectation is withdrawn. Topic: The Rendered Barcode Is A 95-Module Symbol, Not The EAN-8 The Editor Shows
Statement: Measured from a photograph of the ZKTEST-3 preview on 2026-08-19. Across 208 independent scan columns, 197 give 59 runs and 30 bars. EAN-8 is 43 runs and 22 bars; UPC-A and EAN-13 are both 59 runs and 30 bars. The symbol is therefore 95 modules wide even though the editor field reads EAN8 and the human-readable text next to it reads 24081901. Hand-decoding the first four digits from the median run widths -- guard 1,1,1 then 3,2,1,1 / 3,2,1,1 / 3,2,1,1 / 2,1,2,2 -- yields 0,0,0,2, i.e. the payload left-padded with zeros. zbar returns 000240879077 consistently across 93 crops, angles and blur levels; replacing every 7 with 1 gives 000240819011, which is the payload padded to eleven digits with check digit 1 appended and has a valid checksum. Confusing 1 with 7 is the classic symptom of widened bars. Conclusion: the encoder receives the patched payload intact -- which confirms CL-STORAGE-REC-125 -- but does not render it as EAN-8. The scanned content differs from the digits printed beside it. The ZXing Android app failed to read the code off the live screen; whether that is optical or structural is not yet decided.
Next_Test: Feed the photo file to ZXing rather than pointing it at the live display. If it decodes, the symbol is well formed and the live-screen failure was optical. If it still refuses, the symbol is structurally invalid, most likely a wrong check digit.

Topic: The SoC Has No USB Host Controller -- U Disk Support Is Dead Text
Statement: PROVEN 2026-08-20 from three independent directions. (1) The firmware contains "N3290 MSC Library (%s)" at 0x00277404, initialised at 0x0027704C -- that is the Nuvoton USB DEVICE mass storage library. A full-image scan finds no host stack at all: zero occurrences of OHCI, EHCI, UMAS, usbh, usb_host or udisk as symbols. (2) The pinout carries only UD_DM and UD_DP on pins 26 and 27 plus UD_CDET on 86; there is no second USB pin pair and no OTG ID pin. (3) The whole image contains exactly two drive numbers, 0: and 3:. There is no 1: or 2:, so no volume was ever registered for removable media. Confirmed on the device the same evening: an OTG adapter with a stick, with and without external supply, produces nothing, and the USB icon in the file dialog lists an empty directory. The strings "No U disk or U disk format error!" (0x003F2ACC) and "Refresh USB..." (0x003F2B3C) exist in every one of the twelve languages and are inherited UI text from a sibling product that had a host controller. On this model the feature cannot work, and no amount of firmware patching changes that. Topic: The USB Menu Item Is A Volume Handover, Not A Role Switch
Statement: CORRECTION of the hypothesis raised earlier in the same session, which held that the manual activation existed because a single PHY had to be switched between host and device role. That is wrong -- there is no host role (see the preceding row). The real reason is exclusivity: the MSC gadget exports the same FAT volume the firmware itself is using, drive 3: with the label MINI, which holds obds/fonts, obds/res and the firmware binaries. Two masters on one FAT filesystem corrupt it, so the firmware must stop using the volume before handing it to the PC. The menu entry is therefore an unmount-and-hand-over switch, which is also why it cannot run in the background and why it sits waiting for a PC to enumerate it.
Next_Test: Confirm that the firmware releases or remounts the volume around the handover by watching whether a file written from the PC is visible to the device only after ejecting.

Topic: The Firmware Imports .xls, .csv, .txt And .log Files
Statement: Found 2026-08-20. FUN_0026F2B8 at 0x0026F2B8 is the import dispatcher. It takes a filename, seeks to the last four characters via strlen, and compares them against four literals stored contiguously at 0x0026F3E8: ".xls", ".csv", ".txt", ".log", followed by the fopen mode string "rb" at 0x0026F408. If none match it returns 0. On ".xls" it branches to FUN_002B5444, which is the libxls path -- xls_open_ole, xls_parseWorkBook, xls_parseWorkSheet, xls_makeTable and xls_addCell are all linked in. The other three extensions take the generic reader path through FUN_0020D704 and FUN_0021111C with a 0x6000-byte buffer. It also writes the constant 5 as a type tag into the target structure. This is the data path behind the UI labels Variable, Form File, New Table, Var Barcode, Columns and Digits at 0x003F2CE0 ff. The practical consequence is large: variable data does not need the BIFF format at all, a plain CSV or TXT is accepted. Topic: Which Volume The Import Dialog Lists, And What MSC Actually Exports
Statement: Two open questions that together decide whether data can be pushed from the PC without pulling the card. First: FUN_0026F2B8 receives a ready-made filename, and it is not yet known which volume and directory the file dialog scans -- 3: is the FAT volume the PC sees as MINI, 0: is the other registered drive. Second, and more important: it is not established whether the MSC gadget exports the whole SD card as a block device or only the FAT partition. If it exports the whole card, the raw document store at 0x28000000 is writable from the PC over USB, and make_document.py could deliver straight into the printer with no card reader and no disassembly. ANSWERED 2026-08-20 by measurement instead of the proposed lsblk test. MSC exports a 64 MiB window beginning at 0x02A614000, not the whole card, so the document store at 0x28800000 is NOT reachable from the PC in the stock firmware. The import dialog lists the MINI volume inside that window: a file copied there over USB appears under the USB icon. See the superseding row for the full geometry.

Topic: The MINI Volume Sits At 0x02A614000 -- Measured Geometry
Statement: MEASURED 2026-08-20 on sdcard.after_unbenanntxls_auf_mini-minimal.img, a dump taken directly after copying one file onto MINI over USB. The volume the printer exposes as USB mass storage begins at absolute byte 0x02A614000 (LBA 1388704, 678.1 MiB into the card), well behind the document store at 0x28800000. Layout: MBR at 0x02A614000 with signature 55AA and a single partition entry, type 0x06 FAT16, start LBA 63, 131009 sectors; boot sector at 0x02A61BE00 with 512 bytes per sector, 8 sectors per cluster (4 KiB), 1 reserved sector, a single FAT of 64 sectors and 512 root entries; root directory at 0x02A624000; data area, cluster 2, at 0x02A628000. The count 131009 is byte-for-byte the same figure the PC reported for /dev/sda1 in the fdisk output of session 2025-11-28, which identifies this region as exactly what MSC exports. The copied file is proven present: volume label MINI at 0x02A624000, long name entry Untitled.xls at 0x02A624020, 8.3 entry UNTITLED.XLS at 0x02A624040 with first cluster 3 and size 5632 bytes, and the file content beginning with the OLE signature D0 CF 11 E0 at 0x02A629000, which is precisely the address the BPB predicts for cluster 3. Directory entry and content agree.

Topic: 62 Free Zero Sectors Between MBR And Partition -- The Mailbox
Statement: MEASURED 2026-08-20. Inside the exposed 64 MiB window the MBR boot code area, bytes 0 through 445 of the sector at 0x02A614000, is entirely zero -- there is no boot loader. Sectors 1 through 62 of the window, absolute 0x02A614200 through 0x02A61BDFF, are entirely zero as well: 62 sectors, 31744 bytes, lying between the MBR and the start of the partition at LBA 63. They belong to no filesystem and hold no code. Write protect was reported off by the PC. This is therefore a region a host can write over USB with dd of=/dev/sda seek=1 while MSC is active, without touching the FAT and without any risk of filesystem corruption -- which is what made the exclusivity of the USB mode a problem in the first place. It is the intended landing zone for a command mailbox: the PC deposits a record plus a flag, patched firmware notices the write and acts. Room is ample for a text plus a barcode payload; a complete 0x4D000 document record does not fit and would need either chunking or a widened window in our own build.

Topic: Hook Point For The Mailbox: The WRITE(10) Path In msc_scsi_dispatch_278bb0
Statement: The remaining half of the mailbox design. msc_scsi_dispatch_278bb0 at 0x00278BB0, 300 bytes, was named in earlier work and is the SCSI command dispatcher of the N3290 MSC device library initialised at 0x0027704C. What is not yet established: which branch handles WRITE(10) opcode 0x2A, how the incoming LBA is translated into an address on the SD card -- that translation must contain the window base 0x02A614000 or an equivalent constant, which would confirm the geometry from the card side rather than by inference -- and how much room there is to graft in a check for LBA 1 through 62. Note the direction of travel: this is deliberately not the path the device was designed for. The stock firmware makes USB exclusive; our own build does not have to, because the mailbox lies outside the filesystem and no arbitration with the FAT is needed.
Next_Test: From msc_scsi_dispatch_278bb0 follow the opcode switch to the WRITE(10) branch, find the LBA to card-address translation and the constant it uses, and measure the space available for a hook.

Topic: LCD Init Sequence Is In BOOT.bin, Not APP.bin
Statement: The display bring-up happens in the bootloader, at BOOT.bin +0x52C and +0x5E0, before APP.bin is loaded. +0x52C itself is the window setter writing CASET 0x2A, RASET 0x2B and RAMWR 0x2C; the full initialisation chain runs from +0x5E0. This matters for any modification: the display is already configured by the time the application firmware starts, so a patch that wants to change display behaviour has two different binaries to consider.

Topic: Einstiegsbefehl Und Prio-Spalte
Statement: Der Wiedereinstieg in eine neue Sitzung ist ein einziger Befehl: python3 tools/scripts/next.py. Er ruft check_truth.py, druckt die Arbeitsfront (Prio=now, hoechstens sechs Zeilen) mit dem jeweils naechsten Test, die Restmenge nach Prio und Subsystem sowie den Git-Stand. Dazu traegt TRUTH.csv eine 19. Spalte Prio mit den Werten now/next/later/park; check_truth.py erzwingt sie und begrenzt die Front auf sechs Zeilen. Grund: 128 offene Zeilen sind keine Karte, sondern eine Wand -- eine neue Sitzung konnte daraus nicht ableiten, woran sie arbeiten soll.

Topic: Die Offene Menge War Ueberzeichnet -- Gemessene Reduktion
Statement: Gemessen am 2026-08-20 an 128 offenen Zeilen. 98 davon stammten unveraendert aus der Phase-1-Reconciliation vom Januar, nur 30 aus laufender Arbeit. Drei Reduktionen vor jeder neuen Untersuchung: (a) Propagation -- CL-HARDWARE-REC-013 (Display 'wahrscheinlich ST7789V') ist durch CL-DISPLAY-REC-002 beantwortet, CL-DISPLAY-REC-003 (LCD-Helfer im APP-Ghidra nachpruefen) durch CL-DISPLAY-REC-113 (die Helfer stehen in BOOT.bin); (b) CL-STORAGE-REC-016 war aus vorhandener Evidenz entscheidbar; (c) 16 TOOL-Zeilen beschreiben unser Werkzeug, nicht das Geraet, und sind geparkt. Rest: 109 echte Geraetefragen, davon 79 kalte Altlast. Derselbe Befund wie CONTRADICTION-USB-001 im Januar, nur kleiner: Entscheidungen propagieren nicht von selbst.

Topic: Ladeadressen Im DDR -- 0x00200000 Fuer APP.bin, ~0x00700000 Fuer BOOT.bin
Statement: ENTSCHIEDEN 2026-08-20 durch Rechnung an den Binaerdateien; loest den Widerspruch auf, der unter jeder bisher genannten Funktionsadresse lag. Im Register standen drei verschiedene Basisadressen: 0x00200000 (die Ghidra-Datenbank arbeitet damit), 0x02000000 (CL-TOOL-REC-016) und 0x03000000 (CL-BOOT-REC-008). 0x03000000 ist der ROH-OFFSET von APP.bin auf der SD-Karte, keine RAM-Adresse -- der SoC hat 8 MB DDR (CL-SOC-REC-005), der Adressraum endet also bei 0x007FFFFF; 0x03000000 und 0x02000000 liegen beide ausserhalb. Bestaetigung mit Basis 0x00200000: das Wort bei Dateioffset 0xAFB4C ist exakt 0xB1008000, bei 0xAFB40 exakt 0xB1008704 -- genau die Literale, die CL-USB-REC-101 unter VA 0x002AFB4C/0x002AFB40 verzeichnet. Bei 0x65FE0/0x65FE4 stehen e3a07a4d und e3a085a2, decodiert MOV r7,#0x4D000 und MOV r8,#0x28800000 -- genau die Werte aus CL-STORAGE-REC-123. Unter den beiden anderen Basen laegen diese Offsets ausserhalb der Datei. BOOT.bin selbst ist hoeher gelinkt: seine ausgerichteten Literalworte haeufen sich zwischen 0x00700000 und 0x00703200, dazu Puffer bei 0x00280000 und 0x002D8000. Konsequenz: VA = 0x00200000 + Dateioffset ist bestaetigt, alle bisher genannten APP-Adressen bleiben gueltig. ABGELOEST 2026-08-31 durch CL-BOOT-REC-113: die BOOT-Haelfte (0x00700000) stimmt, die APP-Haelfte nicht. Bestaetigt wurde hier nur, dass die Dateioffsets zur Ghidra-Basis passen -- das ist die Konvention der Datenbank, nicht die Linkbasis. Diese liest man aus dem Scatter-Table, und sie lautet 0x00058000.

Topic: WRITE Path And Mailbox Hook Point -- Resolved
Statement: ANSWERED 2026-08-20; it also corrects the premise of CL-USB-REC-116. 0x00278BB0 is NOT the SCSI dispatcher. It is the WRITE data phase, renamed msc_write_data_phase_278bb0. The dispatcher is FUN_002775D0, 2276 bytes, renamed msc_bot_cbw_dispatch_2775d0, and it is the only caller of 0x278BB0. It receives the 31-byte CBW through usb_bulk_out_recv_278ac8 (0x00278AC8), checks the signature 0x43425355 USBC (literal at 0x00277EC8) and works on a copy at RAM 0x000082BC: +0x08 dCBWDataTransferLength, +0x0D bCBWLUN, +0x0F CDB[0]. The opcode switch is at 0x002777B4 -- 0x2A WRITE(10) and 0xAA WRITE(12) share one branch, 0x28 READ(10) and 0xA8 READ(12) another at 0x00277924. The WRITE branch enters the data phase from three sites: 0x0027786C when the CDB length equals dCBWDataTransferLength, 0x00277888 when the host announces less, 0x002778B0 when it announces more (residue). The data phase takes the LBA from 0x000082CD (CBW+0x11), moves the payload in 128 KiB chunks of 0x100 blocks and calls usb_lun_write_blocks(LBA+offset, blocks, buffer) at 0x00278C50 and 0x00278CD0, writing only when CBW+0x0D equals the LUN number at state 0x000082EC+0x94. The LBA to card translation is a single addition inside usb_lun_write_blocks (0x0021CA60): card byte address = 0x2A614000 + LBA*512, the constant being the literal at 0x0021CAAC. Hook space: that function is 76 bytes and 19 instructions, followed immediately by its literal and from 0x0021CAB0 by the next function. There is no inline padding anywhere on this path, so a hook must redirect the two BL sites at 0x00278C50 and 0x00278CD0, where LBA, block count and buffer already sit in r0, r1 and r2. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Die Adressen dieser Zeile sind in der alten Zaehlweise Dateioffset + 0x200000 notiert. Auf der Linkbasis 0x00058000 (alt minus 0x1A8000): 0x00278BB0 -> 0x0D0BB0, 0x00278AC8 -> 0x0D0AC8, 0x00277EC8 -> 0x0CFEC8, 0x002777B4 -> 0x0CF7B4, 0x00277924 -> 0x0CF924, 0x0027786C -> 0x0CF86C, 0x00277888 -> 0x0CF888, 0x002778B0 -> 0x0CF8B0, 0x00278C50 -> 0x0D0C50, 0x00278CD0 -> 0x0D0CD0, 0x0021CA60 -> 0x074A60, 0x0021CAAC -> 0x074AAC, 0x0021CAB0 -> 0x074AB0, FUN_002775D0 -> FUN_000cf5d0. Der Befund selbst ist davon nicht beruehrt.

Topic: The CBW Is Normalised Before Parsing -- A Trap For Readers Of This Code
Statement: Found 2026-08-20 while resolving CL-USB-REC-117. msc_cbw_normalize_276e50 (0x00276E50, called at 0x00277674) copies the 31 received CBW bytes from the raw receive buffer at *(0x000082EC) into the working copy at 0x000082BC, but not verbatim: bytes 0x00-0x10 and 0x19-0x1E are copied straight, while bytes 0x11-0x14 (CDB[2..5], the LBA) and 0x15-0x18 (CDB[6..9], the transfer length) are copied in REVERSE order. The helper that reads those fields afterwards, 0x0020E268, renamed get_u32_unaligned_le_20e268, is a little-endian unaligned 32-bit load -- verified byte for byte: E5D02001 E5D01000 E5D03002 E5D00003 E1811402 E1811803 E1810C00 E12FFF1E. Read without the normalizer the code looks like a big-endian SCSI CDB parsed by a little-endian loader, which for every host LBA below 256 would resolve to sector 0 and destroy the volume; that reading is wrong and the measured card image (CL-STORAGE-REC-131) refutes it. The two halves have to be read together. Consequence for any patch: take the LBA from the working copy at 0x000082CD, where it is already little-endian, never from the raw CBW. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Die Adressen dieser Zeile sind in der alten Zaehlweise Dateioffset + 0x200000 notiert. Auf der Linkbasis 0x00058000 (alt minus 0x1A8000): 0x00276E50 -> 0x0CEE50, 0x00277674 -> 0x0CF674, 0x0020E268 -> 0x066268. Der Befund selbst ist davon nicht beruehrt.

Topic: The Exposed USB Window Is Defined By Exactly Two 32-bit Literals
Statement: The base 0x2A614000 that decides where the MSC LUN starts on the raw card occurs exactly twice in the whole 2577964-byte APP.bin: at file offset 0x1CA5C, the literal of usb_lun_read_blocks (0x0021C998), and at 0x1CAAC, the literal of usb_lun_write_blocks (0x0021CA60). Byte search over the file, 2026-08-20; Ghidra scalar search finds neither, which is CL-TOOL-REC-101 once more and the reason both search modes were run. Both functions guard on (base & 0x1FF) == 0, so any replacement has to be 512-byte aligned. If nothing else derives the window geometry -- the capacity reported to the host has since been located and is NOT a constant, see CL-USB-REC-120 -- then those two words are an eight-byte patch that moves the entire exported window, and pointing it at 0x28800000 would expose the 100-slot document store to the PC directly. That would make the mailbox in the 62 free sectors (CL-STORAGE-REC-132) unnecessary and would answer the transport half of the slave goal outright. PRECONDITION SETTLED 2026-08-31 (probe B2), in the direction that favours the patch: base and capacity are decoupled in code. usb_lun_read_blocks and usb_lun_write_blocks take 0x2A614000 from their own literal pool and never touch *(0x7D8); no instruction in the image writes an MBR-derived value to +0x98; and 65536 is not a code constant anywhere in APP.bin -- 0x10000 does not occur among the 1895 distinct pool constants, and none of the 32 mov Rd,#0x10000 sites stores to +0x98. Of the 53 stores to +0x98 exactly one is a PDISK_T constructor (0x0025164C, instruction for instruction SDCARD_Open from SIC/Src/SDGlue.c:541-570), and it feeds from the card CSD into a different PDISK_T at *(0x974+0x10). Moving the two base literals therefore needs no second edit. NOT settled: who writes 65536 -- see CL-BOOT-REC-112 for why that writer is not in APP.bin at all. One coincidence must not be over-read: the MBR at 0x2A614000 declares LBA 63 plus 131009 sectors = 131072 sectors = exactly 65536 KiB, and which of the two derives from the other cannot be decided from code alone. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Die Adressen dieser Zeile sind in der alten Zaehlweise Dateioffset + 0x200000 notiert. Auf der Linkbasis 0x00058000 (alt minus 0x1A8000): 0x0021C998 -> 0x074998, 0x0021CA60 -> 0x074A60, 0x0025164C -> 0x0A964C. Der Befund selbst ist davon nicht beruehrt. PATCH VORBEREITET 2026-10-12 (Basis 0x58000): tools/scripts/patch_usb_window.py. Nachgeprueft: sha256 3be9028b...; 0x2A614000 als Literal genau bei Datei 0x1CA5C und 0x1CAAC; keine MOV/ADD/ORR/SUB/EOR-Immediate-Kette im ARM-Code bildet 0x2A614000, 0x150A0, 0x2A61BE00 oder 0x150DF (eigener Decoder, Positivkontrolle: findet mov #0x28800000 bei 0xB7234, 0xC3060, 0xC335C, 0xC754C; Thumb-Bereich nicht dekodiert). usb_lun_read_blocks (0x74998) und usb_lun_write_blocks (0x74A60) werden nur aus msc_read_data_phase (0xD03E8) bzw. msc_write_data_phase (0xD0BB0) gerufen und rechnen Sektor = (Basis + LBA*512) >> 9 ohne weitere Grenze. Die mov #0x20000 bei 0xCF46C/0xD046C/0xD0C18 sind 128-KiB-Transferpuffer, keine Kapazitaet. Beide Literale liegen im Dateisektor 0xE5; APP.bin liegt roh ab 0x03000000, also ist der Kartenpatch genau Rohsektor 98533 (0x0301CA00), 6 geaenderte Bytes; dieser Sektor ist in sdcard.after_saving_textplusbarcode-minimal, afterboot-minimal und clean-raw byte-gleich mit dem Original. Gepatchte Kopie sha256 d3b5ba03.... ABGRENZUNG ZUM BRICK CL-USB-REC-016: Datei 0x275140 = VA 0x2CD140 liegt im komprimierten RW-Block (Scatter-Quelle 0x2CCBE4..0x2CD22C), den __scatterload_decompress beim Start entpackt; die Literale hier liegen im RO-Code. FOLGEN DES FENSTERS 0x28800000..0x2C800000: die 100 Slots enden genau bei 0x2A614000 (100 x 0x4D000 = 0x1E14000), dahinter sieht der PC MBR und Anfang des MINI-Volumes; Sektor 0 des Fensters ist der Kopf von Slot 0 (Magic 0x2022, keine 55AA-Signatur), ein Betriebssystem sieht also eine unformatierte Platte -- einen Formatierungsdialog nie bestaetigen, am besten unter Linux ohne Automount testen. Solange der Patch aktiv ist, ist MINI nicht mehr als Laufwerk erreichbar. AM GERAET BESTAETIGT 2026-10-12 (O3): Testkarte (29,7 GB, /dev/sdc) frisch mit sdcard.minimal.img bespielt, eingerichtet, zwei Dokumente gespeichert (Ablage-Sicherung: Slot 0 Kopf 22 20 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 00.., Slot 1 22 20 00 00 01 00 00 00 02 00.., Slot 2 0xFF). Patch mit patch_usb_window.py auf Rohsektor 98533 (vorher f16d21b6..., nachher 08e414c3...). Geraet bootet normal. Setup -> USB: der PC sieht ein Geraet 'SPI Disk' mit 64M; dd Sektor 0 = 22 20 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 ... (Kopf Slot 0), Sektor 0x4D000/512 = 22 20 00 00 01 00 00 00 02 00 ... (Kopf Slot 1). Das USB-Fenster zeigt damit auf die Dokumentablage 0x28800000; Slot k liegt am Fensteroffset k*0x4D000. Schreiben ueber USB ist noch nicht geprueft.

Topic: Candidate Free Space For Hook Code In APP.bin
Statement: APP.bin is 0x27522C bytes and, at load base 0x00200000, ends at 0x0047522C. The largest contiguous run of zero bytes in it is 27974 bytes at file offset 0x000CC34E, VA 0x002CC34E to 0x002D3093. It is not trailing padding: it sits between two data tables -- small 32-bit counters before it, pointers of the form 0x00248FXX after it -- so it looks like the unused middle of a sparse table rather than dead space. The next largest runs are 263 and 131 bytes, i.e. nothing else in the image is big enough to matter. Because the whole file is loaded to 0x00200000, whatever the file holds is present in RAM, so this is the only candidate region for hook code that needs no relocation.
Next_Test: Prove the region is never addressed: scan the image for literal words falling inside 0x002CC34E-0x002D3093 and check the index arithmetic on the two neighbouring tables. If it looks clean, fill it with a recognisable pattern in a test image, boot, re-dump and confirm the pattern is untouched and the device still works.

Topic: The Reported LUN Capacity Is Runtime State, Not A Constant
Statement: ANSWERED 2026-08-20, the half of CL-USB-REC-119 that had to be settled first. READ CAPACITY (opcode 0x25) is handled at 0x00277B44 in msc_bot_cbw_dispatch_2775d0 and answered by msc_read_capacity_278514 (0x00278514): it clears 36 bytes of the shared buffer, writes state(0x000082EC)+0x3C minus one as the last LBA in big-endian order into bytes 0..3 and sets byte 6 to 2, i.e. a block length of 0x200. The value in state+0x3C is put there by msc_lun_set_capacity_21984c (0x0021984C, 52 bytes), which checks the LUN number against state+0x94 and then computes blocks = *( *(0x000007D8) + 0x98 ) * 2 -- the doubling matches a size held in KiB, as in the Nuvoton DISK_DATA_T.diskSize field, converted to 512-byte blocks. The value is confirmed by measurement: the kernel log of session 2025-11-28 reports 131072 512-byte logical blocks, 64.0 MiB, for /dev/sda, so *(0x7D8)+0x98 is 65536. Consequence for the eight-byte window patch: base and size are decoupled, the size is not a code constant and does not have to move with the base, and a 64 MiB window placed at 0x28800000 would cover the whole 100-slot document store, which needs only 100 * 0x4D000 = 30.1 MiB. What remains open is who writes 65536 into that field. STRUCTURE CORRECTED 2026-08-31 (probe B2): the field is NOT DISK_DATA_T.diskSize. In vendor/N32901-3_NonOS_BSP/NVTFAT/lib/nvtfat.h:222-248 the type physical_disk_S (PDISK_T) puts uDiskSize, documented as a size in Kbytes, at exactly +0x98, sizeof 0xC0; DISK_DATA_T carries diskSize at +0x08 and LDISK_T at +0x20 counting sectors, so neither fits. The KiB reading itself is confirmed: the lsl #1 at 0x0021986C is the KiB-to-512-byte-block conversion, and 65536 KiB * 2 = 131072 blocks is what the host measured. That *(0x7D8) IS a PDISK_T remains an offset match against a header, not a symbol; the doubt is recorded as a set_comment at 0x00219868. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Die Adressen dieser Zeile sind in der alten Zaehlweise Dateioffset + 0x200000 notiert. Auf der Linkbasis 0x00058000 (alt minus 0x1A8000): 0x00277B44 -> 0x0CFB44, 0x00278514 -> 0x0D0514, 0x0021984C -> 0x07184C, 0x0021986C -> 0x07186C, 0x00219868 -> 0x071868. Der Befund selbst ist davon nicht beruehrt.

Topic: The UI String Table Is A Grid Of Parallel 200-Entry Language Blocks
Statement: Measured 2026-08-21 on APP.bin (VA = file offset + 0x200000). The table is not one block per language of arbitrary shape but a grid: consecutive blocks of 200 entries, each entry a NUL-terminated string padded to a 4-byte boundary -- 4, not the 8 claimed in CL-DISPLAY-REC-111. The English block runs 0x003F2890..0x003F32FC and parses to exactly 200 entries with no empty slot; 'Solid ' is entry 0, Bold=43, Password=46, Distance=49, Sync Mode=51, Language=55. Blocks are parallel, i.e. entry i is the same label in every language: in the German block Sprache and Abstand sit at the ordinals English gives Language and Distance, agreeing to within one slot, the residue being untranslated (empty) slots that a non-empty-only scan silently skips. The region holds about 22 blocks from 0x003F1164 to roughly 0x00405438: Simplified and Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Turkish, Arabic, Russian, German (0x003FA824), Dutch, Thai, Ukrainian, Kazakh, Uzbek, Indonesian, Slovak, Croatian, Persian, Lithuanian, Latvian and an Indic block. CL-DISPLAY-REC-111 named six languages and put Dutch at 0x003FB4xx; that address is the Thai block. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Die Adressen dieser Zeile sind in der alten Zaehlweise Dateioffset + 0x200000 notiert. Auf der Linkbasis 0x00058000 (alt minus 0x1A8000): 0x003F2890 -> 0x24A890, 0x003F32FC -> 0x24B2FC, 0x003F1164 -> 0x249164, 0x00405438 -> 0x25D438, 0x003FA824 -> 0x252824. Der Befund selbst ist davon nicht beruehrt.

Topic: Nothing In APP.bin Points At The UI String Table
Statement: Decisive negative, 2026-08-21, re-verified without relying on Ghidra. No 32-bit word anywhere in the 2576940-byte APP.bin equals the address of any string in the language region 0x003F1164..0x00405410 -- byte search over every offset, aligned and unaligned; the 69 numeric coincidences are round values such as 0x00404040 and 0x003FF000 that fall on a string start by chance. Three further sweeps, all own decoders over the raw file rather than tool queries: (a) all 5551 LDR Rd,[pc,#imm] literal loads enumerated and the word each one loads inspected -- 9 hold a value inside the region, 8 of them the bitmask 0x00404040 and one a mid-string address, none on a string start; (b) all 1173 ARM PC-relative ADR (ADD/SUB Rd,PC,#imm) targets computed -- two land in the region, both false positives decoded out of the string bytes themselves; (c) multi-immediate constant chains (MOV seed followed by ORR/ADD/SUB/EOR on the same register) -- none reaches the region. That last sweep also shows why the pool sweep is decisive: the whole image contains only 15 such chains, so this compiler materialises 32-bit constants from the literal pool essentially always, and the pool is covered exhaustively by the byte search. Method fitness shown by control: the same byte search does find the stored words for strings that are used, e.g. '3:/obds/res/ZK-INKJET-RES-HW.zkml' (0x0025D14C) at 0x002FFAC8 and 0x002FFC94, '%s.zkml' (0x0026B2F0) at 0x00380270. The per-language base pointer that CL-DISPLAY-REC-111 set out to find does not exist in APP.bin; the address has to be produced by arithmetic or come from outside the image.

Topic: Ein Menueeintrag Erreicht Seinen String Ueber Ein Zur Laufzeit Gefuelltes String-Feld
Statement: The geometry is settled (CL-DISPLAY-REC-114) and the obvious route is ruled out (CL-DISPLAY-REC-115): the firmware reaches the table without any stored pointer, immediate or ADR target. What remains is a base computed at runtime -- from the language setting, from a resource descriptor, or from a symbol assembled across several registers, none of which either constant search can see. This is the last piece before UI handlers become addressable by label, which is what makes the print trigger findable. BEANTWORTET 2026-10-11 durch CL-DISPLAY-REC-118: der Basiswert wird nicht berechnet, er steht als Zeigertabelle je Sprache bei 0x00152398 im Image; der Sprachlader FUN_000B4814 kopiert die 222 Strings der aktiven Sprache in das Feld 0x00124350 + i*126, und UI-Beschreibungen zeigen auf diese Feldeintraege. Die Annahme 'kein gespeicherter Zeiger' war ein Artefakt der falschen Basis.

Topic: ADR Und Immediate-Ketten Sind Zwei Weitere Suchmodi
Statement: CL-TOOL-REC-101 and CL-TOOL-REC-108 established that Ghidra scalar search misses constant-pool words and that a byte search over the file misses ARM immediates, so both must be run. Two further modes were needed on 2026-08-21. First, ADR: ADD/SUB Rd,PC,#imm, where the target appears nowhere -- not as a pool word because it is computed, not as an operand because the operand is the displacement. Decode it as word & 0x0FFF0000 == 0x028F0000 for ADD and 0x024F0000 for SUB, immediate = ror(word & 0xFF, 2*((word>>8) & 0xF)), target = PC+8 +/- imm; APP.bin holds 1173. Second, multi-immediate chains, a MOV seed followed by ORR/ADD/SUB/EOR on the same register -- search_scalars cannot see these by construction and says so in its own method note. Two traps go with this. A scalar search for a value that is not an encodable ARM immediate is a meaningless query, not a negative result: 0x003F2890 cannot be an 8-bit-rotated immediate at all, so asking for it proves nothing. And a monotone table can land on 82% of the 4-aligned addresses in a range by construction, so a high hit rate against a candidate set proves nothing without a density baseline -- that trap cost a false lead on the 12-byte record table at 0x003BF550. Practical consequence: the GhidraMCP bridge was in trial on 2026-08-21, so an empty tool result is a prompt to re-run the question with an own decoder over the raw file, which is what carries CL-DISPLAY-REC-115. Ghidra itself passed its fitness control there -- search_scalars('0x28800000') returns mov r8,#0x28800000 at 0x00265FE4 as CL-STORAGE-REC-123 recorded. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Die Adressen dieser Zeile sind in der alten Zaehlweise Dateioffset + 0x200000 notiert. Auf der Linkbasis 0x00058000 (alt minus 0x1A8000): 0x003F2890 -> 0x24A890, 0x003BF550 -> 0x217550, 0x00265FE4 -> 0x0BDFE4. Der Befund selbst ist davon nicht beruehrt.

Topic: The CDC Reference Implementation Ships In The BSP We Already Have
Statement: Found 2026-08-21, closing CL-USB-REC-015, which guessed at a related N9H26 BSP on chat evidence (E1, 0.70). No guess needed: vendor/N32901-3_NonOS_BSP/UDC/example/VCOM/ is a complete USB-CDC ACM implementation for this SoC family, alongside HID_class, mass_storage, mass_storage_CDROM, UAVC_class and video_class. VirtualCom.c carries the full descriptor set: two interfaces, bNumInterfaces=2. Interface 0 is the CDC communication class (bInterfaceClass 0x02, SubClass 0x02, Protocol 0x01) with one endpoint 0x83, bmAttributes 0x03 (interrupt IN), wMaxPacketSize 0x0040, bInterval 1. Interface 1 is the CDC data class (bInterfaceClass 0x0A) with two endpoints, 0x81 bmAttributes 0x02 (bulk IN) and 0x02 (bulk OUT), both wMaxPacketSize 0x0200 = 512, i.e. high-speed. A Windows INF ships with it at UDC/example/VCOM/WindowsDriver/NuvotonCDC.inf. The prebuilt libs in UDC/lib are named w55fa93_MSC_*, the mass-storage class the device currently presents. That the vendor ships a working CDC for this exact UDC is the single most favourable fact for the slave goal so far.

Topic: The UDC Has Four Non-Control Endpoints, Not Six
Statement: Decided 2026-08-21 against a contradiction inside the vendor documentation. N3290x_Design_Guide_A1.pdf says six configurable endpoints on page 11 and four configurable endpoints in addition to the control endpoint on page 484 (chapter 6.13.1). The BSP settles it and outranks the Design Guide, being compiled for this chip variant: UDC/lib/usbd.h declares exactly four endpoint callbacks and their number fields, EPA to EPD (pfnEPACallBack..pfnEPDCallBack, i32EPC_Num, i32EPD_Num), and the strings EPE and EPF do not occur anywhere in UDC/lib. This matches CL-USB-REC-012, which lists EPA_CFG and EPB_CFG under USBD_BA. So the budget is four non-control endpoints plus control. It is enough: the BSP's own CDC (CL-USB-REC-121) uses three of them, two bulk plus one interrupt, leaving one spare. Page 11 of the Design Guide is wrong for this variant or describes a different family member; it should not be quoted for endpoint count.

Topic: UDC Interrupt Is IRQ 16 In The AIC Vector Table
Statement: The AIC vector table on page 625 of N3290x_Design_Guide_A1.pdf lists entry 16 as UDC_INT, source register SCR5[7:0], level low -- the USB Device Controller interrupt. The neighbours are 17 SIC_INT (Storage Interface Controller) and 18 UHC_INT (USB Host Controller), and 14/15 are TMR0_INT/TMR1_INT via SCR4. This gives a second handle on the USB stack independent of the register base 0xB1008000 from CL-USB-REC-011: the AIC vector table in APP.bin, once located, names the UDC interrupt service routine directly, and the ISR is where enumeration and endpoint handling live. The USB chapter itself is 6.13 from page 484, with the register group summary (Main Control, USB Control, Control Endpoint, Non-control Endpoint, DMA) on page 485.

Topic: Whether The Firmware Links The Nuvoton UDC Library Is Untested
Statement: CL-USB-REC-121 shows the vendor ships a working CDC for this UDC. What decides how much work the slave goal is: whether the printer firmware was built against that same Nuvoton UDC library. If it was, the descriptor tables and the endpoint setup in APP.bin will have the shape of the BSP examples, and adding or swapping a CDC interface is a descriptor and configuration change rather than a stack rewrite. If it was not, the CDC has to be brought in against an unknown stack. CL-USB-REC-016 already records that a descriptor patch at file offset 0x275140 bricked the device, so the descriptor region is real but not safely editable blind. NACHTRAG 2026-10-11: APP.bin enthaelt bei Dateioffset 0xAFB1C den Formatstring 'N3290 UDC Library (%s)' mit dem Datum '20180315' unmittelbar davor, bei 0x77404 'N3290 MSC Library (%s)' mit '20170606' -- dieselben Strings und Daten stehen in vendor/N32901-3_NonOS_BSP/UDC/lib/w55fa93_UDC.lib und w55fa93_MSC_SPI.lib (strings). FID findet udcClose bei 0x1077C8 nur mit gesenkter Schwelle (Score 8.0), drei MSC-Funktionen sind bis auf den Literalpool-Abstand gleich (CL-TOOL-REC-123). Die Versionsgleichheit ist gemessen; dass die Firmware die UDC-Bibliothek dieser Version einbindet, ist der naheliegende Schluss, aber per Bytevergleich nicht bestaetigt, weil der UDC-Code im Image anders uebersetzt ist (CL-TOOL-REC-125). BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): durchgesehen, keine Umrechnung noetig. 0x275140 ist ein Dateioffset, keine Adresse. ENTSCHIEDEN 2026-10-12 (O1): Die Firmware linkt die Nuvoton-UDC-Bibliothek und die MSC-Klassenbibliothek aus dem BSP, MSC in der Variante TEST_SPI. Drei unabhaengige Belege: (1) der USB-ISR 0x109AC4 ist usbd_isr Zweig fuer Zweig, Registerfolge gleich (CL-USB-REC-102) -- das war Probe 3 des Next_Test; (2) die Deskriptor- und Inquiry-Tabellen sind byte-gleich zu mscd.c (CL-USB-REC-127) -- Probe 1, nur liegen sie komprimiert in der RW-Region und nicht im Klartext, weshalb eine Bytesuche im Image sie nicht findet; (3) die Feldoffsets von usbdInfo (0x8190) und mscdInfo (0x82EC, MSC_INFO_T) passen an jedem gemessenen Zugriff, und der Ablauf in Starter FUN_0008a75c / Stopper FUN_0008a790 ist wortgleich zu UDC/example/mass_storage/main.c: udcOpen, mscdInit, mscdFlashInit, udcInit, mscdBlcokModeEnable(FALSE), mscdMassEvent(NULL) bzw. mscdDeinit, udcDeinit, udcClose. Variante TEST_SPI: mscdFlashInit setzt F_SD/F_SM/F_RAM/F_CDROM_LUN auf 0xFF und F_SPI_LUN = 0, ruft Flash_Identify (0x7184C, hier angepasst, bisher msc_lun_set_capacity_21984c); mscdInquiry_Command setzt 'SPI Disk'; mscdMassEvent enthaelt keinen SD-Kartencheck. Topic: The PDF Reader Truncates To Five Pages Unless Told Otherwise
Statement: The pdf-reader MCP was reactivated and checked on 2026-08-21 after the system rebuild. It works, with two traps that make a working tool look broken. First and dangerous under rule 6: pdf_search and pdf_read process only the first five pages of a document unless pages is given or allow_full_document is set to true. A search over the 897-page Design Guide returned zero hits on the first attempt -- which reads as a negative finding and is nothing of the sort; the same query with allow_full_document returned six hits. The truncation is reported in a warnings field, but total_hits sits next to it reading 0, and the tool's own usage example omits the parameter. Second: pdf_info cannot be called from this client at all. Its parameter is source, singular and untyped in the schema, and arrives at the server as a string, which it rejects with 'source: Expected object'. The tools taking sources (plural, an array) serialise correctly and work. Paths must be absolute; the server's working directory is not the repository.

Topic: PDF Reader Behoben -- Alle Acht Werkzeuge Laufen
Statement: Abloesung von CL-TOOL-REC-115 noch am selben Tag: beide dort beschriebenen Fehler sind behoben und nachgeprueft. pdf_info laeuft und liefert fuer N3290x_Design_Guide_A1.pdf 897 Seiten, Titel 'ENGLISH TECHNIQUE PAPER', Autor Winbond Electronics Corp., Sprache zh-TW, Fingerprint 85bfe922b1622347b58e7e645bf0f0be, 897 Bilder, kein Inhaltsverzeichnis. pdf_extract_image laeuft ebenfalls und liefert das UDC-Blockdiagramm von Seite 485 als PNG. pdf_search durchsucht jetzt ohne Zusatzparameter das ganze Dokument und weist das im Ergebnis mit pages_searched und total_pages nach -- damit ist total_hits: 0 ein pruefbarer Negativbefund und nicht mehr die stille Fuenf-Seiten-Kuerzung. Bei gesetztem max_hits bricht die Suche frueher ab, was pages_searched offen ausweist. Zur Redlichkeit gehoert der eigene Fehler dazu: die in CL-TOOL-REC-115 genannte Ursache war falsch. Der Parameter source war nie untypisiert, er stand von Anfang an als type: object mit properties im Schema; untypisiert ist die Untereigenschaft pages, und die wurde verwechselt. Das Symptom -- Validation error: source: Expected object, an pdf_info und pdf_extract_image reproduziert -- war echt, die Diagnose daneben. Lehre fuer die naechste Fehlermeldung: das Schema zitieren, nicht aus dem Gedaechtnis wiedergeben.

Topic: GT32L24M0140.spiflash Is A Font Resource Reference, Not A Confirmed Physical Chip
Statement: APP.bin references "3:/obds/res/GT32L24M0140.spiflash" and "3:/obds/res/GT30L24A3W.ZB25VQ32.spiflash" as font resource files read via the FAT volume mount, string offsets ~0x5D1C8-0x5D208. GT32L24M0140 is a Genitop CGROM font-chip family, and ZB25VQ32 is a Zbit SPI-NOR part number embedded in the second filename. Whether these describe an actual font IC on the board or are inherited filenames for a resource the firmware now loads from the SD card is undetermined; board inspection found no unidentified SPI flash or font-ROM package.
Next_Test: Mount 0:/ (or wherever 3:/obds/res/ resolves) on sdcard.work.img and check whether GT32L24M0140.spiflash and GT30L24A3W.ZB25VQ32.spiflash exist as files; if present, dump and compare against known Genitop/Zbit font-ROM dumps. If absent, check whether the firmware has a software fallback path for missing font resources (both modes: literal and immediate search for the string load site around 0x5D1C8).

Topic: 0xB8003000 Is RTC_BA, Not An Encoder Capture Block
Statement: The BSP header defines RTC_BA = 0xB8003000 with INIR at +0x000, AER at +0x004, CLR at +0x010, DWR at +0x018. The routine at VA 0x28F9A8 writes 0xA5EB1357 to INIR and 0xA965 to AER, then polls bit 16 of AER with a 10000-iteration timeout -- verbatim the RTC unlock sequence the Design Guide prescribes (INIR releases the counters, AER=0xA965 sets the ENF access-enable flag). The routine at VA 0x232664 writes to +0x10/+0x14/+0x18/+0x1C, i.e. it loads calendar, time and day-of-week. Both are real-time-clock code. This REFUTES the RE-KB reading of 2025-12-20, which took the two documented magic constants for a hardware trigger sequence and concluded 0xB8003000 was a dedicated encoder capture block. The measurement in that session was correct; only the attribution of meaning was guessed. SECOND INSTANCE of the same transposition in the same session: finding-0024/0027 (status verified, confidence 1.0) records that FUN_0006fd70 toggles the display D/C line on "GPIO base 0xb8003000". Measured: the constant pool around VA 0x26FD70 holds only 0xB8001000 (GPIO_BA, at VA 0x26FD10, 0x26FD8C, 0x26FDD0) and 0xB800C000 (SPI0_BA, at 0x26FD14, 0x26FD6C, 0x26FDF4); 0xB8003000 does not occur anywhere in 0x26F000-0x270000. The D/C toggle uses GPIO_BA. Both display and encoder findings from 2025-12-20 name the RTC base where GPIO was meant, so any CL-DISPLAY row descending from finding-0024/0027 needs its MMIO bases re-checked before it is relied on. CORRECTED AND EXTENDED 2026-08-22: the transposition appears in THREE findings, not two -- 0024, 0025 and 0027 all name 0xB8003000 for the display D/C line. The measured base is GPIO_BA+0x38 = REG_GPIOD_DOUT, bit 13, i.e. D/C is GPD[13], consistent with the display hanging on SPI0 across GPD12-14. The bit number in those findings was right, the base and the port were wrong. All other bases in findings 0024/0025/0027/0028/0030 check out against the BSP header (SPI0_BA, PWM_BA, CLK_BA+0x08). Separately, finding-0025 names FUN_0001d5a4, but VA 0x21D5A4 is not a function entry -- it lies inside the body of the block 0x21D244-0x21D774, which does contain the 13 calls to the command writer. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Die Adressen dieser Zeile sind in der alten Zaehlweise Dateioffset + 0x200000 notiert. Auf der Linkbasis 0x00058000 (alt minus 0x1A8000): 0x28F9A8 -> 0x0E79A8, 0x232664 -> 0x08A664, 0x26FD70 -> 0x0C7D70, 0x26FD10 -> 0x0C7D10, 0x26FD8C -> 0x0C7D8C, 0x26FDD0 -> 0x0C7DD0, 0x26FD14 -> 0x0C7D14, 0x26FD6C -> 0x0C7D6C, 0x26FDF4 -> 0x0C7DF4, 0x26F000 -> 0x0C7000, 0x270000 -> 0x0C8000, 0x21D5A4 -> 0x0755A4, 0x21D244 -> 0x075244, 0x21D774 -> 0x075774. Der Befund selbst ist davon nicht beruehrt.

Topic: Port E Register Access Sites Located By Literal Search
Statement: Each of the three GPIO port E registers appears exactly once as a 4-aligned literal in APP.bin: REG_GPIOE_OMD 0xB8001040 at file 0x32238 (VA 0x232238), REG_GPIOE_DOUT 0xB8001048 at file 0x322BC (VA 0x2322BC), REG_GPIOE_PIN 0xB800104C at file 0x31F30 (VA 0x231F30). VA 0x231F30 is therefore the only site that reads port E pin state through a fully-formed address. Register offsets are from the BSP header (GPIO_BA 0xB8001000). These sites plus VA 0x232664 and 0x232730 form one contiguous GPIO block roughly VA 0x231F00-0x232800. The base+offset caveat has since been settled by disassembly of all eleven GPIO_BA load sites: such accesses do exist and are common -- REG_GPIOE_DOUT (+0x48) is reached twelve times from five of the eleven sites against a single literal hit, and REG_GPIOE_PUEN (+0x44) is written although the constant 0xB8001044 never appears in the image -- but none of the eleven touches +0x4C, directly or via an add-derived address, and no ARM or Thumb immediate chain forms an address in 0xB8001000-0xB80010FF. VA 0x231F30 therefore stands as the only port E reader. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Die Adressen dieser Zeile sind in der alten Zaehlweise Dateioffset + 0x200000 notiert. Auf der Linkbasis 0x00058000 (alt minus 0x1A8000): 0x232238 -> 0x08A238, 0x2322BC -> 0x08A2BC, 0x231F30 -> 0x089F30, 0x232664 -> 0x08A664, 0x232730 -> 0x08A730, 0x231F00 -> 0x089F00, 0x232800 -> 0x08A800. Topic: GPE[9] Is Polled, GPE[10] Is Configured For Interrupt
Statement: VA 0x231F30 is the literal pool entry of FUN_00231EC4, a port-generic pin reader: param_1 selects one of the five PIN registers via 1/2/4/8/0x10, param_2 is a bit number, and the mask is formed as 'ands r0,r2,r0,lsl r1', i.e. 1<<param_2 -- not a constant. Of its five callers (corrected 2026-10-17, was 'four'; own BL decoder and Ghidra xrefs agree) exactly one passes port E: FUN_0026FBF8 at VA 0x26FC08 with bit 9, mask 0x200. The other four, in the new counting: 0x89E2C GPD4, 0x89E58 and 0x89EB0 GPB0, 0xB2B44 GPB14 (the software-I2C data line, CL-FIRMWARE-REC-127). The surrounding code takes a 64-bit tick from absolute address 0xC18, adds 0xBB8 (3000) and spins until the deadline; the tick is incremented from a routine that checks TMR_BA+0x18 (REG_TISR). GPE[10] is configured separately at VA 0x25C3A0 with mode byte 0x23, and that value takes the branch in FUN_00231F34 which claims an interrupt slot and writes 1<<irq to AIC_BA+0x120. GPE[9] is configured with mode 0x02 and does not take that branch. So the pin carrying the MT6701 is interrupt-driven, and the polled port E pin is a different one. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Die Adressen dieser Zeile sind in der alten Zaehlweise Dateioffset + 0x200000 notiert. Auf der Linkbasis 0x00058000 (alt minus 0x1A8000): 0x231F30 -> 0x089F30, 0x26FC08 -> 0x0C7C08, 0x25C3A0 -> 0x0B43A0, FUN_00231EC4 -> FUN_00089ec4, FUN_0026FBF8 -> FUN_000c7bf8, FUN_00231F34 -> FUN_00089f34. Der Befund selbst ist davon nicht beruehrt.

Topic: The MT6701 Signal Is Evaluated In A GPIO Interrupt Handler
Statement: Pin 117 offers no capture or PWM function (MF_GPE10: GPIOE[10] or NALE only), the MT6701 emits PWM as measured with a scope, and GPE[10] is configured for interrupt (CL-HARDWARE-REC-112). The reading is therefore that edge interrupts plus the 64-bit tick at 0xC18 reconstruct the encoder value in software. The handler itself has not been identified; this is inference from the configuration, not from the handler code. NACHTRAG 2026-10-12 (CL-FIRMWARE-REC-118): Die GPIO-Handler sind gefunden. GPE10 -> EXTINT1, ISR 0x8249C -> 0xB65C8, der nur [0x5B8+0x24]++ macht; GPE11 -> EXTINT0, ISR 0x8247C -> 0xB623C, jede fuenfte Flanke [0x5B8+0x20]++. Keiner liest den Tick 0xC18 oder ein PIN-Register -- die Lesart 'Flanken plus Tick rekonstruieren einen PWM-Wert' ist damit widerlegt; die Firmware zaehlt Flanken. Welcher Zaehler am MT6701 haengt, ist CL-HARDWARE-REC-113: die Firmware nennt den GPE11-Zaehler 'Encoder' und den GPE10-Zaehler 'External' (Lichtschranke). ABGELOEST 2026-10-12 durch CL-HARDWARE-REC-113: am Geraet zaehlt beim Drehen der GPE11-Zaehler ('Encoder'), nicht GPE10.
Next_Test: Entfaellt in der bisherigen Form; der Handler ist gelesen. Offen ist nur noch die Zuordnung Pin <-> Signal: Geraetetest aus CL-HARDWARE-REC-113.

Topic: Where Is The Raster Path To The Print Head?
Statement: OPEN, raised 2026-08-31 by CL-FIRMWARE-REC-103. The barcode encoder feeds the preview on the ST7789 panel, so the path from document data to HP45 nozzle firing is not reachable by following the encoder downwards. Two entry points remain untried: the document reader side (CL-USB-REC-108) and the print-parameter consumers (Startsignal / Synchronmodus, CL-HARDWARE-REC-110), which must hand a bitmap to whatever drives the head. Eintrag 2 hp45_set_primitives 0xD8B44: Bits 0-7 -> GPA0-7, 8-9 -> GPA10-11, 10-13 -> GPD5-8 (14 Bits). Eintrag 3 0x10C06C Stopp. Eintrag 4 delay_us 0x9EEC0 (Timer n*24 bei 24 MHz). Direkt aufgerufen werden nur Eintrag 0 und 3, aus print_job_run und dem Test-Handler 0xBAEF0 (Taste 0x163 'Test'). print_job_run feuert nicht selbst: es ueberwacht die Druckstruktur im RAM bei 0x5B8 (Poolwort 0x84080), zaehlt bei Ende eines Etiketts den Zaehler +0x148 hoch, bereitet mit 0xBC690 das naechste vor und behandelt 0x16A Pause, 0x146 Zaehler loeschen und 0x1B Abbruch. Topic: Function Size And range.end Disagree On Non-Contiguous Functions
Statement: For FUN_0025B338 list_functions_in_range reports size 1696 (computed end 0x25B9D7) while analyze_function_complete reports range.end 0x25B9FB -- 0x24 bytes apart. boot_init shows the related pattern from the other side: it is non-contiguous, with a 392-byte body at 0x25B0C4 and a separate 4-byte chunk at 0x273EE4, and list_functions_in_range lists the two as two entries under the same name. Suspicion, not established: size sums the body chunks while range.end spans to the last address including trailing pool, so any reasoning that treats either number as the function boundary can be off. Until this is settled, a function end taken from one of the two calls is not a reliable bound. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Die Adressen dieser Zeile sind in der alten Zaehlweise Dateioffset + 0x200000 notiert. Topic: The Oracle Ceiling Check Only Sees Rows Touched After The Cutover
Statement: check_truth.py line 196 restricts the ceiling check to rows with Updated >= ORACLE_AB, so a row that carried an oracle tier and a confidence above its ceiling before the cutover is never reported. Found on 2026-08-31 by accident: editing CL-FIRMWARE-REC-101 for unrelated reasons set Updated to today and the violation surfaced immediately, although it had been there all along. A scan of the whole file ignoring the date filter returns 17 rows on O2 with confidence 1.00: CL-STORAGE-REC-101, -103, -117, -131, -132; CL-BOOT-REC-103, -104, -111; CL-DISPLAY-REC-101; CL-TOOL-REC-101, -106, -108, -114; CL-HARDWARE-REC-106; CL-USB-REC-104, -117; CL-FIRMWARE-REC-102. That set includes the load-address row carrying twelve dependants and all three load-bearing tool rows. Not an error of substance in itself -- for several of them the tier is what is wrong, not the number, because the evidence is device behaviour and belongs on O3. The defect is that old and new rows are held to different standards without that being written down anywhere, which is the same shape of problem as the unpropagated supersessions of January: a rule that exists but does not reach the rows it was written for.

Topic: A Second Resident Code Image Lives Below 0x00200000 -- And It Is Not The Block At SD 0x100000
Statement: APP.bin holds absolute pointers below its own load base that resolve under neither base 0x200000 nor base 0. The clearest is the callback 0x0008A434, loaded as a pool word at four independent sites (0x25E2A8, 0x25F230, 0x26B048, 0x26F544) and called as blx r6 / blx r11 in FUN_0028A248 and FUN_0028A3DC with (raw address, buffer, 0x10); 0x0008A500 is used the same way. The globals the MSC path depends on live in the same region: 0x7D8, 0x82EC, 0x974, 0xB80, 0xD00 all read back null from Ghidra because they lie outside every mapped block. So a second code and data image is resident below 0x200000, and the writer of *(0x7D8) -- the open half of CL-USB-REC-119 -- is very probably in it rather than in APP.bin. RULED OUT 2026-08-31: it is not the ~2.99 MB block at SD offset 0x100000. That block does start with a proper ARM vector table and does contain ARM code at 0x8A434, 0x8A500 and 0xD9934 when read at base 0, which is why it looked like the answer -- but a blx target must be a function entry, and at 0x8A434 there is no stmdb sp! within the preceding 1600 bytes, while at 0x8A500 and 0xD9934 the last entry lies 12 and 456 bytes back. The block also contains no pool word 0x7D8 at all and no store of 65536 to +0x98 (45 stores to that offset, none preceded by mov Rd,#0x10000). It is a relative of the resident image, consistent with CL-BOOT-REC-104 calling it an earlier generation, but it is not the running one. ABGELOEST 2026-08-31 durch CL-BOOT-REC-114: die Praemisse "resolves under neither base" war ein Artefakt der falschen Basis. Unter der gemessenen Linkbasis 0x00058000 sind 0x0008A434, 0x0008A500 und 0x000D9934 gewoehnliche Funktionen in APP.bin, und die Globals liegen in dessen eigener scatter-geladener RW/ZI-Region.

Topic: Pool-Word Searches Produce False Callers Inside Data Regions
Statement: Searching for a function address as an aligned word finds an apparent caller for almost any address once the search reaches a data region. Measured in probe B2 for the span 0x37C000-0x39A000: of 30720 words, 23382 (76.1%) fall inside 0x200000-0x2D0000, 22960 of them distinct, covering 10.8% of all aligned addresses in that span. The raw content shows why -- from 0x003997A0 there is a dense near-monotonic run with stride 8 (0x28A198, 0x28A1A0, 0x28A1A8, ...) and another around 0x00386FC0 with stride 0x2BC. Such a run hits essentially every aligned address in its neighbourhood by itself. Consequence for method: an aligned word equal to a function address is not evidence of a call. Only real bl/blx targets count as callers, and a pool-word hit is only usable when the load that reads it is shown. BASIS-VERMERK 2026-10-12 (CL-BOOT-REC-113, Datenbank seit CL-TOOL-REC-121): Der Bereich 0x200000-0x2D0000, gegen den die Poolworte gezaehlt sind, ist der Codebereich in alter Zaehlweise; in der neuen entspricht er 0x058000-0x128000. Die uebrigen Adressen der Zeile umgerechnet: 0x37C000 -> 0x1D4000, 0x39A000 -> 0x1F2000, 0x003997A0 -> 0x001F17A0, 0x28A198 -> 0x0E2198, 0x00386FC0 -> 0x001DEFC0. Der Befund (dichte Tabellen erzeugen Schein-Aufrufer) bleibt. ABGELOEST 2026-10-17 durch CL-TOOL-REC-129: the 76.1% were counted against the old code range 0x200000-0x2D0000, which is data in the right base (VA = file + 0x58000, CL-BOOT-REC-113); in the right base 5 of 30720 words fall into code, none aligned -- the runs are real pointers into data; maintainer OK 2026-10-17

Topic: APP.bin Ist Nach 0x00058000 Gelinkt, Nicht Nach 0x00200000
Statement: GEMESSEN 2026-08-31 aus dem Scatter-Table der Binaerdateien selbst; loest CL-BOOT-REC-111 ab, dessen BOOT-Haelfte stehen bleibt. Beide Images beginnen mit demselben armlink-Startstub (__scatterload_rt2): bei +0x60 werden PC-relativ zwei Offsets geladen, die auf eine Tabelle am Dateiende zeigen, jeder Eintrag (src, dst, size, fn) mit absoluten Adressen des gelinkten Adressraums. Fuer APP.bin steht die Tabelle bei Dateioffset 0x27487C und hat drei Eintraege: (0x002CCB84 -> 0x00000000, 0x60, fn 0x000580F8), (0x002CCBE4 -> 0x00000060, 0xC84, fn 0x0005809C), (0x002CD22C -> 0x00000CE4, 0x442DC, fn 0x00058120). Vier unabhaengige Wege liefern dieselbe Basis 0x00058000: (a) die drei fn zeigen auf die Helfer __scatterload_copy/_decompress/_zeroinit, die im Stub bei +0xF8/+0x9C/+0x120 liegen -- die 176 Bytes ab Dateioffset 0x9C sind in APP.bin und BOOT.bin byteidentisch; (b) der Zero-Init-Eintrag traegt als src das Imageende, 0x002CD22C = 0x58000 + Dateigroesse 0x27522C, exakt; (c) der erste Eintrag kopiert 0x60 Bytes nach VA 0, das ist die ARM-Vektortabelle, und ihr Reset-Wort bei +0x20 lautet 0x00058000, also genau Dateioffset 0 von APP.bin; (d) von 2753 durch ldr Rd,[pc,#imm] referenzierten Literalworten fallen unter 0x00058000 750 ins Image und 59 davon auf einen push{..,lr}-Funktionsanfang, unter 0x00200000 nur 20 und keines. Positivkontrolle ist BOOT.bin, dessen Basis 0x00700000 unabhaengig bekannt war: dort liefern dieselben vier Wege 0x00700000, und sein Reset-Wort lautet 0x00700000. KONSEQUENZ: alle bisher notierten APP-Adressen der Form "VA 0x002xxxxx" sind Dateioffset + 0x200000, also die Basis der Ghidra-Datenbank, nicht die Adresse im laufenden Geraet. Die korrekte VA ist Dateioffset + 0x00058000 = bisherige VA minus 0x1A8000. Die Dateioffsets und damit jeder Byte- und Codebefund bleiben unveraendert gueltig; falsch war nur das Etikett. Zwei bisher unerklaerte Beobachtungen loesen sich damit auf: der USB-ISR 0x00109AC4 aus CL-USB-REC-102 galt als "nicht in APP.bin abgebildet" und liegt bei Dateioffset 0xB1AC4 auf einem sauberen str lr,[sp,#-4]!-Prolog, und die Callbacks 0x0008A434 / 0x0008A500 / 0x000D9934 aus CL-BOOT-REC-112 liegen bei 0x32434 / 0x32500 / 0x81934 auf push-Prologen. BOOT.bin bleibt bei 0x00700000, Groesse 0x31C0; seine Tabelle hat vier Eintraege und nullt zusaetzlich 0x00280000 Bytes ab 0x002D8000 -- also den Bereich direkt oberhalb des APP-Images, das bei 0x002CD22C endet.

Statement: GEMESSEN 2026-08-31; loest CL-BOOT-REC-112 ab, dessen Praemisse mit der falschen Basis 0x00200000 stand. Es gibt kein zweites residentes Codeimage. Topic: Die Gemeldete LUN-Kapazitaet Ist Statisch Vorgegeben -- 65536 KiB
Statement: GEMESSEN 2026-08-31, schliesst die offene Haelfte von CL-USB-REC-119. Der RW-Block 0x60-0xCE4 ist ausgerollt: der Entpacker __scatterload_decompress ist aus dem Thumb-Code ab Dateioffset 0x9C nachgebildet (Token-Byte, lit=token&7 bzw. Folgebyte, run=token>>4 bzw. Folgebyte, lit-1 Literale, dann bei gesetztem Bit 3 eine Rueckwaerts-Referenz ueber run+2 Bytes, sonst run Nullbytes). Positivkontrolle ist BOOT.bin, wo derselbe Eintrag 0x24 Quellbytes auf genau 0x180 Bytes ausrollt; fuer APP.bin sind es 0x645 von 0x648 verfuegbaren Quellbytes auf genau 0xC84. ERGEBNIS: *(0x000007D8) ist statisch mit 0x00000718 belegt, und *(0x00000718 + 0x98) = *(0x000007B0) ist statisch 0x00010000 = 65536. Das ist exakt der Wert, den CL-USB-REC-120 aus der Geraetemessung zurueckgerechnet hat -- das Kernel-Log vom 2025-11-28 meldet 131072 Bloecke zu 512 Byte, also 65536 * 2. Der Zeiger und die Groesse sind damit Anfangswerte aus dem Image, nicht Laufzeitzustand: es muss sie niemand schreiben, damit die beobachtete Kapazitaet zustande kommt. Der Rueckschluss "irgendein Schreiber muss vor der Enumeration laufen" faellt weg, und mit ihm der Grund, ihn zu suchen. KONSEQUENZ FUER CL-USB-REC-119: das exportierte Fenster ist vollstaendig statisch -- Basis 0x2A614000 aus den zwei Literalen bei Dateioffset 0x1CA5C und 0x1CAAC, Laenge 64 MiB aus diesem Wort. 64 MiB ab 0x28800000 decken den kompletten 100-Slot-Dokumentspeicher ab (100 * 0x4D000 = 0x2FA0000, rund 30 MiB), der Patch verkuerzt das Fenster also nicht.
